qa_flags.question: Charles Shi (Needham) asked, based on orders and customer engagement, how big the second half of 2026 could be.
qa_flags.response_pattern: Rafi and Ramy both repeated they feel 'very comfortable' 2026 will be a growth year with H2 better than H1, but explicitly said they cannot anticipate exact numbers this far out (citing only 3-4 month delivery lead times) and gave no figures.

qa_flags.question: Michael Mani (BofA) asked whether idle/underutilized customer tool capacity, particularly at HBM customers, could be a headwind partly explaining the softer first-half-2026 outlook.
qa_flags.response_pattern: Ramy said the company does not actually know customer utilization data ('they keep them very close to their chest') and stated he cannot comment on it, without directly addressing the utilization-as-headwind premise of the question.

qa_flags.question: Matthew Pan (Barclays, on for Tom O'Malley) asked what percentage of total AI compute investment Camtek thinks WFE spend represents, noting other companies cite high-single to double-digit percentages.
qa_flags.response_pattern: Ramy acknowledged seeing estimates ranging from high single digits to low double digits from others, but said it is 'a little premature' to comment on WFE in 2026 and did not offer Camtek's own number.

qa_flags.question: Brian Chin 追問加速需求較集中在 HBM 還是 chiplet logic，且下半年 step-up 落在 Q3 還是 Q4
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層表示現階段無法給出 Q3 或 Q4 的解析度，稱視客戶而定，只重申「下半年會看到這個 step」，未給具體季度

qa_flags.question: Edward Yang 追問維持並擴大市占是否有具體時間點或決策節點可觀察
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層表示無法揭露確切時間框架與決策時點，僅重申對維持並提升市占「非常有信心」，未提供可驗證的日期或客戶名稱

qa_flags.question: Jim Schneider 與 Edward Yang 先後兩次追問 2026 年整體營收相對同業引述的 WFE 成長率（15%-20%、20%+ 或低雙位數）會落在哪裡
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層兩次均以「現在量化還太早」回應，未給出具體數字或區間，僅重申過去幾年表現優於 WFE

qa_flags.question: Gus Richard 追問 KLA 封裝相關營收去年成長 70%，為何與 Camtek 的成長率有落差
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層先表示不確定對方採用的基準、不願誤判比較基礎，再轉向強調自身未流失市占，未直接對比兩者的成長率數字
